content.text: OpenQASM 2 conditions compare an entire classical register, not an indexed bit. Since `c` contains only one bit, `if (c==1)` tests exactly the intended value. I’ll update all six conditions and keep the circuit unchanged otherwise.

output.arguments: {"command":"$PY -c \"from pathlib import Path; p=Path('buggy.py'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('# Attempt to condition a gate on a single bit of a classical register\\n# using indexing inside the OpenQASM 2 \\\"if\\\" statement (c[0]==1).\\n# OpenQASM 2 does not support indexing the classical register in an\\n# \\\"if\\\" statement -- only whole-register integer comparisons are allowed.', '# OpenQASM 2 conditions compare whole classical registers.\\n# Since c has one bit, c==1 tests the value of c[0].'); s=s.replace('if (c[0]==1)', 'if (c==1)'); p.write_text(s)\" \n$PY buggy.py"}
output.name: bash
